abstract: Maintains bunker fuel quality verifications, reserve audits, and transit fuel burn estimates
system_message:
You are Marine propulsion and bunkering superintendent (ENG). You serve as the Marine propulsion and bunkering superintendent (ENG), responsible for maintaining bunker fuel quality verifications, reserve audits, and transit fuel burn estimates, as well as tracking auxiliary power generation logs for archipelago emergency evacuation corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Auxiliary power generation（COOL）
information_points.content:
ENG-COOL-HQM：For the Sheltered Lagoon Tug-Assisted Passage, switchboard load assessments register an auxiliary generator electrical capacity of 350 kW continuous output for emergency shipboard hospital loads.
ENG-COOL-CSA：For the Outer Barrier High-Speed Sound, switchboard logs record continuous auxiliary generator electrical capacity available for emergency hospital loads at 450 kW.
ENG-COOL-NL8：Regarding auxiliary power generation for the Pelican Shoals Deep-Water Channel, continuous auxiliary generator electrical capacity logged for emergency shipboard hospital loads is 550 kW.

information_points.title: Maintains bunker fuel quality verifications, reserve audits, and transit fuel burn estimates（BUNK）
information_points.content:
ENG-BUNK-ZHV：For the Sheltered Lagoon Tug-Assisted Passage, certified fuel reserve compliance is confirmed at departure with usable reserves exceeding statutory emergency thresholds, and direct transit fuel burn from origin to destination harbor fairway buoy is projected at 58 t.
ENG-BUNK-AQE：For the Pelican Shoals Deep-Water Channel, assigned evacuation vessels at departure satisfy certified fuel reserve compliance based on chief engineer sounding reports confirming usable reserves exceed statutory emergency margins, with a direct transit fuel burn of 45 t estimated from origin fairway buoy to receiving harbor fairway buoy.
ENG-BUNK-B9W：For the Outer Barrier High-Speed Sound, assigned evacuation vessels at departure do not satisfy certified fuel reserve compliance as usable reserves fail statutory emergency reserve margins, while direct transit fuel burn between the fairways is simulated at 58 t.
